name: Autonomous Repair & Patch Verification
purpose: Perform an explicitly authorized repair inside an isolated workspace and produce a verified patch artifact.
allowed: apply bounded patch inside authorized scope

deep_audit.01_purpose: Bounded authorized repair and patch verification.
deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Repair, scope, patch, workspace, verification and evidence controls.
deep_audit.03_inputs: T03, T17, T18, T19 and repository baseline evidence.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Immutable repair result and verification evidence.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: T17 impact, T19 diagnosis and test plan.
deep_audit.08_downstream_consumers: Future publication, commit, deployment and review layers.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Authorization, scope, baseline, patch, syntax, verification and rollback failures.
deep_audit.10_security_boundary: AI output is untrusted candidate data.
deep_audit.11_determinism: Scope, identity and final verdict are deterministic.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Failed repairs are discarded from isolated workspace.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Hallucination, stale context, over-broad edits and fake success are controlled.
deep_audit.16_cross_chat_continuity: Repair fingerprints and receipts preserve continuity.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Only isolated bounded workspace and evidence artifacts.
deep_audit.20_observability: Repair, authorization, scope and verification fingerprints.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: T18 authorizes, T20 repairs and verifies.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: Publication, commit, deployment and learning remain separate.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Repair identity includes authorization and baseline fingerprints.
deep_audit.25_versioning_migration_compatibility: Schema and policy versions are explicit.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Scope escape, malicious patch and policy bypass are blocked.
